# cb:b579

> OKF bundle doc discovery (CB.Okf.Manifest.doc_paths/1, shared with the validator) enumerates markdown docs via Elixir's Path.wildcard, whose default match_dot: false skips dot-directories - so the beliefs/nursery/threads/.sessions/ draft area is structurally invisible to manifest build and validation. The leading dot in .sessions is load-bearing: it is what keeps the frontmatter-less, per-turn-rewritten session drafts out of the validated bundle. Passing match_dot: true to that wildcard, or renaming the directory without the dot, would silently pull the drafts into discovery and break manifest validation.

**Type:** attestation · **Kind:** design-property · **Domain:** system · **Status:** active
**Tags:** `okf`, `manifest`, `threads`, `transcript`, `dot-dir`
**Created:** 2026-07-02

**Artifact:** [`code:lib/cb/okf/manifest.ex#Path.wildcard(Path.join(root, "**/*.md"))`](../../../lib/cb/okf/manifest.ex)

## Evidence

1. **2026-07-02** - Surfaced while deliberating whether .sessions should be de-dotted after its renders became committed (the ride-along lane made the 'gitignored working area' reading of the dot stale). Inspection of doc_paths/1 showed discovery uses bare Path.wildcard with no match_dot option, so Elixir's default (dot-dirs unmatched) is the only mechanism excluding .sessions/ drafts from the bundle; a graph and docs sweep found zero occurrences of match_dot, meaning the exclusion was entirely implicit in one line of code. The dot was retained and its rationale re-read: not 'gitignored' but 'outside the validated bundle'.
